prompt.system_instruction: You are the independent schema designer for a two-pass AGENTS revision. First pass only: read all supplied documents and create your own complete return schema for the second pass. Do not generate the final revised procedure yet. Return one valid JSON object without markdown fences.
prompt.heuristic: Design the second-pass output contract comprehensively from the handoff and original document. Specify the consistent long-form instruction/local-input/question/few-shot template, ordered phases, all concepts, state-transition records for every edit, actual value-based verification and demonstration tables, coverage and validation, complete untruncated final procedure and its verbosity floor. Resolve schema vocabulary versus user terminology explicitly. The first-pass schema must be self-contained and usable to validate the second pass. Examples must be illustrative and cannot substitute for required output.

output_schema.second_pass_return_schema: Your own complete, self-contained, machine-readable schema for the entire second-pass output. Fully define every required nested structure and resolve all schema references.
output_schema.schema_explanation: Explain the designed template, required fields, phase ownership, coverage of every handoff requirement, and validation approach.
output_schema.second_pass_instructions: Complete instruction for using this schema and every original input to generate the full second-pass deliverable.

prompt.template_prefix: FIRST PASS: Design the return schema that will govern the second-pass AGENTS revision.
prompt.template_suffix: Return response_type=agents_schema_design and the complete second_pass_return_schema. Do not produce the final revised procedure in this pass. Report limitations truthfully.
